bugs.error_message: SCRIPT ERROR: Cannot call method 'add_child' on a null value.
bugs.root_cause: Combat (child of Player) used player.model in its _ready; the parent's @onready vars aren't set until after children are ready.
bugs.fix: Use player.get_node("Model") in the child's _ready.

bugs.error_message: Amodu renders as glowing brown copper
bugs.root_cause: Meshy's rigged GLB wires the colour texture to emission (factor 1) and sets no metallicFactor, which glTF defaults to 1.0: fully metallic skin.
bugs.fix: _dress_model: emission off, metallic from the model's metallic-roughness map (B), roughness (G), normal map; same UVs as model.glb.

bugs.error_message: AnimationMixer: 'ride_insect', couldn't resolve track: 'target_character/Skeleton3D:Hips'
bugs.root_cause: Meshy text-to-motion GLBs name the skeleton target_character; library clips use Armature/Skeleton3D, so custom motions (crawl, lift, lamp, ride) never played.
bugs.fix: _retarget() points every bone track at the rigged model's skeleton path.

bugs.error_message: Big leap lands twice
bugs.root_cause: The landing clip dive_land has the hips 5 m up at its start (baked travel), so after touch-down the model rose and fell again; the take-off clip run_jump was a dive roll with its own landing.
bugs.fix: Jumps cut into airborne poses (lowest foot pinned to the ground, pose chosen by vertical speed) and one landing clip on touch-down (land_hop / land_heavy).

bugs.error_message: On spawn Amodu sinks into the ground and pops back up
bugs.root_cause: wake_up (Meshy 271) lies with the hips at ground level and never stands; it faded in from standing and out again.
bugs.fix: Player.wake_up(): get_up (Stand Up 1) snapped in with no blend, from lying to standing.

bugs.error_message: Rain has no overcast look: hard sun shadows in a shower
bugs.root_cause: DayClock sets sun.light_energy every frame, so Weather's relative dimming cancelled out.
bugs.fix: DayClock.base_energy; Weather sets energy = base * dim and softens shadow_opacity.

bugs.error_message: Autopilot stuck halfway up the Heartwood Stair inside the trunk
bugs.root_cause: The tree's 120-180 m Meshy roots were centred partway up the new bank and tilted with the wrong sign, so their inner ends ran through the trunk and blocked the stair tunnel.
bugs.fix: Banked roots are 70-105 m, start at the trunk surface, tilt up the slope (+atan2); fungus shelves sit outward of the trunk.

bugs.error_message: Stuck where the stair leaves Root Hall
bugs.root_cause: The stair tube's floor came out through the hall's curved wall ~2 m above the hall floor.
bugs.fix: Solve the helix start height so its floor meets the hall floor exactly where it crosses the floor's edge.

bugs.error_message: Super jump looks like vibrating with a fading ripple
bugs.root_cause: The camera smoothed every frame toward the body's 60 Hz physics position (30 cm steps at leap speed), and its spring arm collided with grass blades, snapping in and out.
bugs.fix: Player.visual_position() interpolates between physics steps (the model is drawn there, the camera follows it); the arm ignores grass.

bugs.error_message: A swimmer's legs show as a white ghost under the water
bugs.root_cause: The foam line paints anything within foam_width of the surface white.
bugs.fix: Thin, broken foam (0.3 m, noise-gated).

bugs.error_message: V switches the camera view and also makes Amodu dodge-roll
bugs.root_cause: The dodge action had V bound as well as Alt; V is also camera_view, so one press fired both.
bugs.fix: Removed V from dodge (Alt and pad Y remain). Check the input map for keys shared between actions.

bugs.error_message: F1 doesn't open the controls panel
bugs.root_cause: On a Mac keyboard F1 is the brightness key unless fn is held, so Godot never receives it; the HUD only listened for KEY_F1.
bugs.fix: New input action 'controls' (H, F1, pad Back); the HUD uses it and the corner hint shows H.

bugs.error_message: Dry lawn in dips looks wet and dark with water caustics, far from the Rut
bugs.root_cause: The ground shader applied its underwater look wherever the ground was below the global water_level; ~13.8k dry lattice points already sat below it (more with terrain relief).
bugs.fix: Uniform water_box (the Rut's bounds + 6 m, set in lawn_builder._ground_material) and the mud weight gate the underwater look.

bugs.error_message: Rain falls inside the cave (Root Hall, the Heartwood Stair)
bugs.root_cause: Rain streaks are GPU particles in a box above Amodu with no collision (deliberately: a height capture would stop rain at the 20 m grass tips), so they fell through the tree bank; splashes only checked the ground below.
bugs.fix: Weather.shelter: a ray up from his head (world+climbable, not grass) fades the streaks out under cover; a splash only lands where a ray up from it finds open sky. GardenAudio muffles the rain and stops nearby drops under cover.

bugs.error_message: Footsteps splash (wading) in the hollow and on the Bare Patch, far from the Rut
bugs.root_cause: Wading was decided by height below the Rut's water level; many dry dips in the lawn lie below it (same trap as bug-013).
bugs.fix: Decide by the bake's surface: WATER, or MUD below level+0.4, wades; everything else by surface type.

bugs.error_message: No push animation when pushing pebbles/boulders (Amodu walks normally into the rock)
bugs.root_cause: The 'push' library clip (Meshy 261) was never wired into the AnimationTree; _pushing only changed speed.
bugs.fix: Ground tree gets push_clip -> push_stride (TimeScale) -> push Blend2 after 'puff'; _push_blend follows _pushing; stride scaled by speed / natural_speed['push'] (builder now measures push).

bugs.error_message: The axe passes through Amodu's leg while he stands or walks
bugs.root_cause: One hand grip tuned for the swing (handle across the palm) points the handle into the thigh when the arm hangs.
bugs.fix: Two grips: rest (handle forward along his side, blade down) and swing (across the palm), blended while an axe clip plays or he blocks (player.current_action()).

bugs.error_message: Controls card cut off at the bottom and on the right
bugs.root_cause: A fixed-size one-column panel (460 px) with 15 rows and a long label.
bugs.fix: Two columns in a SoftPanel sized to its content and centred; shorter labels.

bugs.error_message: Fingers tear into shards / cracks open at the knuckles when the new finger bones bend
bugs.root_cause: (1) Curling the wrong way (palm-normal sign is ambiguous); (2) k-means split through two joined fingers; (3) smoothing gave the copies of a vertex along a UV seam different weights.
bugs.fix: Sign per hand checked by eye (FingerCurl.sign Right +1, Left -1); each vertex goes to the finger whose axis is nearest; weights smoothed per position so seam copies match.

bugs.error_message: Stone knife / axe look bright green / yellow in game
bugs.root_cause: Blender-exported GLBs name images Image_<n> out of index order; the tool matched roles by the number in the name, so the colour texture was compressed as a normal map (RGTC).
bugs.fix: gltf_roles keys roles by image name as well as index; extracted textures named after an image name use it.

bugs.error_message: Axe on his back sticks out sideways; knife not at the waist
bugs.root_cause: Stowed poses were set in the Spine bone's own axes, which point oddly.
bugs.fix: HOLSTERS in the body's axes (+X left, +Y up, +Z forward) at a bone, turned by the bone's change from rest; every owned weapon shown stowed (axe back, knife hip) unless in hand.

bugs.error_message: Opigo shows tiny and Opumie vanishes when given Amodu's old (Mixamo) clips
bugs.root_cause: The ant scout rig is in centimetres (Armature scale 0.01); the user's hero rigs are in metres, so the clips' hips position keys (cm) threw the body ~100x off.
bugs.fix: _library_for scales position tracks by the rig's hips rest height / the idle clip's hips height, and caches per bone set AND scale.

bugs.error_message: Opigo floats above the ground, hunched with clenched fists
bugs.root_cause: The heroes' Mixamo-named rig rests with different bone axes from the rig Amodu's old clips were made for, so copied local rotations bent every joint wrong; hips too high.
bugs.fix: tools/retarget_ant_heroes.gd retargets Amodu2's library per hero in skeleton space (rest-relative world rotations, bone map), scales hips travel and pins the lowest foot to Amodu's (scaled) height; AntModel loads <hero>_animations.res.

bugs.error_message: Companions froze in place (Opumie never led) after the level ended or while a line was up with Amodu moved without velocity
bugs.root_cause: LevelStory._process returned early once finished, so Companion.talk_focus kept the last speaker; talk mode (Amodu near and slow) then held the ants forever
bugs.fix: _face_the_talk() runs before the finished check, so focus clears when nobody talks; tests set player.velocity when moving him by position

bugs.error_message: trowel ramp onto the patio: Amodu stuck at the trowel's foot (Dressing/Solid_* pebble) after route_b was shortened
bugs.root_cause: Scattered solid dressing only avoided main routes, ant roads and haul paths; the trowel was never in _route_lines, and the old route_b to Spider's Edge had been keeping its foot clear by accident. Any re-bake also reshuffles the scatter (one seeded rng over the whole map).
bugs.fix: _route_lines adds the trowel plus 15 m of approach before its foot

bugs.error_message: too far to swim: put back 83 m from the bank (over the water)
bugs.root_cause: _last_dry was saved before the move step, when is_on_floor() was still true from before a teleport, so a point over the Rut was taken as dry ground
bugs.fix: Update _last_dry (and refill swim_left) after the state's move, when is_on_floor() is fresh

bugs.error_message: Worker ants (gate guards, water carriers) stood in a broken, twisted pose
bugs.root_cause: The ant scout (Mixamo-named rig in cm) ran Amodu's old clips copied bone to bone; the names matched but the bones' rest orientations differ, so the rotations twisted the limbs
bugs.fix: tools/retarget_ant_heroes.gd now also retargets Amodu's current library onto the ant scout (creatures/ant_scout/ant_scout_animations.res); AntModel loads it for workers
